about_rt_motors: RT MOTORS specializes in delivering high-quality vehicles from South Korea to customers worldwide. With years of experience, we have established strong partnerships with Korea’s top manufacturers and maintain reliable connections with trusted and competitively priced dealers in the automotive sector.

items.question: Which countries does RT MOTORS export vehicles to?
items.answer: We export vehicles from South Korea to almost every country in the world. Our main destinations include Central Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and Africa.

items.question: How long does shipping take and which factors influence it?
items.answer: Delivery time depends on the destination. For Asia and the Middle East, it usually takes 2–4 weeks, while shipments to Europe and Africa may take 4–8 weeks.

items.question: What documents will I receive after the vehicle is shipped?
items.answer: We provide all necessary documents, including the sales contract, invoice, vehicle registration, Bill of Lading (BL), and customs clearance papers.

items.question: Can I check the condition of the vehicle before purchase?
items.answer: Yes, our team inspects every selected vehicle and provides detailed photos and videos. This way, you can verify the real condition of the car before making your purchase.

items.question: Can RT MOTORS help me find a specific vehicle model?
items.answer: Yes, if you are looking for a particular brand, model, or specification, our team will search and source it directly from trusted Korean markets and auctions.

items.question: Do you offer warranty on exported vehicles?
items.answer: Since vehicles are sold as export units, official warranty is not provided. However, we guarantee that the vehicle’s condition matches the inspection report, photos, and videos we share with you.

items.question: What shipping options are available?
items.answer: We provide two main shipping methods: Ro-Ro (Roll-on/Roll-off) — cost-effective for multiple cars; and Container shipping — secure and suitable for high-value or luxury vehicles.

items.question: Why should I choose RT MOTORS over other exporters?
items.answer: We ensure transparency, professional inspections, reliable shipping, and full document support. Our goal is to make car importing safe, fast, and hassle-free for our clients worldwide.
